calculation.description: Reverse five-session cross-sectional relative performance, with a smooth intensity multiplier that activates when at least half of tradable assets have negative five-session returns and reaches full strength at 80% downside breadth. Computed using only information available at the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC/ICIR by regime: 2020-2022 +0.1057959/+0.2732780 (187 dates); 2023-2024 +0.0648465/+0.1851719 (123 dates); 2025-2027 +0.0141805/+0.0391121 (82 dates). Recent drift is weak but full-sample gates pass; use conditional sizing and revalidate promptly.

notes: Small cross-asset universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments used; daily IC observations require at least 8 valid instruments. Observation-only macro symbols are excluded.
